The pond fills most of the scene, with exactly 10 blooming lotus flowers in pink, peach, and pale yellow, broad green lily pads, and exactly 9 visible koi fish in orange, white, black, and gold swimming in luminous swirling water. Tiny glowing fireflies and magical light specks float throughout the air and reflect on the pond surface. In the midground, an arched wooden bridge crosses the water. In the background, a serene Japanese garden extends with lush greenery, moss, shrubs, a stone lantern on the left, another warm garden lantern on the right, a small traditional pavilion with a dark tiled roof, and trees with red-orange autumn leaves mixed with deep green foliage. Add a few cherry blossom branches near the seated woman. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a square social-media-ready felt-and-embroidery graphic recording board for MakiのAI開発魔法学校, mixing a cute wizard cat mascot with an AI research mind map. The design should look like a handmade felt collage: stitched borders, fabric patches, paper notes, yarn outlines, chalk marks, and tiny sewn stars.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, warm beige craft-paper background, large dark navy chalkboard occupying most of the image, rounded stitched top banner, dense but readable layout, cozy handmade texture throughout.

Main title and headline: At the top, put a cream stitched banner with the title “MakiのAI開発魔法学校” and small gold stars. In the center top of the chalkboard, write “今日の研究魔法” and the large quote 「コードが進化し、エージェントが計画する」, underlined with a pink chalk stroke.

Character: On the left side, place exactly 1 main mascot: a cream felt wizard cat wearing a navy wizard hat and cape decorated with yellow stars, red round glasses, and holding a red wand with a flower-like tip. The cat has simple black stitched facial features and a cute serious expression.

Central diagram: Draw exactly 1 circular chalk-style research cycle in the middle of the board with arrows around it and a small AI-agent face icon at the center labeled “AIエージェント”. Around it place exactly 4 colored felt oval nodes: 1 pink node labeled “コード進化 </>”, 1 blue node labeled “問題発見” with a magnifying glass icon, 1 green node labeled “適応計画” with a checklist icon, and 1 yellow node labeled “ロールプレイ” with small chat/people icons. Use white arrows connecting every node into a loop.

Speech bubbles and callouts: Include exactly 6 stitched cream speech bubbles around the board: 1 upper-left bubble saying “研究はつながって進化する!”, 1 near the cat saying “仕組みで見ると、研究がつながる!”, 1 lower-left bubble saying “新しい問題を見つけて、研究を前へ!”, 1 left-middle bubble saying “コードが進化! より良い解決へアップデート!”, 1 upper-right bubble saying “魔法（しくみ）でAIを育てよう!”, and 1 right-middle bubble saying “役割を演じて、一貫した対話を実現!”. Also add 1 lower-right cream bubble saying “計画を立てて、制約の中でも最適に動く!” if space allows, keeping the stitched style.

Research cards: Along the lower middle, place exactly 5 pinned fabric/paper cards under a small label “本日の研究論文（最新）”. The cards should read, from left to right: 1 pink card “Code2LoRA / コード進化に合わせたLoRA生成 / </>”, 1 yellow card “ArcANE / ロールプレイ言語エージェントの一貫性”, 1 light blue card “TIDE / テンプレート誘導の複数問題発見”, 1 green card “AdaPlanBench / 制約下の適応計画評価”, and 1 small central pink citation strip below them reading “Reinforcement Learning Elicits Contextual Learning of Unseen Language Translation / 未知言語翻訳の文脈学習” with a globe icon.

Side panels and notes: Add exactly 2 dark chalkboard side panels: bottom-left panel titled “研究のサイクル” listing checkmarked steps “問題発見 → コード進化 → ロールプレイ → 適応計画 → また次の問題へ!”, and bottom-right panel titled “コードの例” containing short pseudo-code lines such as “for step in plan: obs = observe(); thought = think(obs); action = act(thought); result = evaluate(); update(code, result)”. Add exactly 1 upper-right pinned paper note titled “コードの魔法メモ” with a short code block: “def think(plan): obs = observe(); act = plan(obs); return act” plus “# evolve(code)” and “# adapt(plan)”.

Bottom area: Include exactly 3 small note clusters along the bottom: 1 yellow checklist note titled “魔法のチェック” with three checkbox lines “つながっている?”, “試せる?”, “再現できる?”, 1 open notebook note titled “研究メモ”, and 1 cream bubble saying “失敗も呪文の材料になるよ!” next to a simple bunny doodle. At bottom right, add a dark stitched banner titled “今日の呪文” with the phrase 進化・役割・計画をセットで読む and a small magic wand.

Decorative elements: Include exactly 1 graduation cap icon in the upper right, 1 atom/science doodle in the upper left, 1 small robot doodle on the right side, many small stitched stars and sparkles scattered across the board, white chalk arrows, pins, tape, and thread seams.

Visual style: Japanese kawaii educational infographic, felt graphic recording, handmade embroidery, soft shadows, tactile fabric texture, chalkboard lettering, whimsical AI magic-school theme, warm beige and navy palette with accents of red, yellow, pink, blue, and green. Make the text legible but preserve the charming hand-drawn irregularity.

Constraints: Use no photorealism, no glossy 3D, no extra mascots beyond the single cat, no watermark, no logo, and keep the square layout balanced for SNS sharing.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical side-by-side comparison poster showing two AI-generated aerial city renderings, one above the other, for a visual model comparison between Banana pro and GPT image 2.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 image, approximately 768×1024 px. Split the canvas into exactly 2 equal horizontal panels with no border or margin between them.

Layout: The top panel fills the upper half and the bottom panel fills the lower half. Each panel shows a similar futuristic waterfront business district at blue-hour dusk from a high oblique aerial view. Place exactly 2 large text labels: the top label in the upper-left corner reading “Banana pro”, and the bottom label in the upper-left area of the lower panel reading “GPT image 2”. Use a tall, blocky, condensed white display font with a dark shadow or outline, similar to retro stencil/gaming typography.

Top panel scene: A polished architectural visualization of a modern urban development beside a river or bay. Include approximately 12 prominent glass office towers and mid-rise blocks arranged on a gridded campus, with glowing rooftop edges, landscaped green roofs, tree-lined roads, and warm street lighting. Show water along the top edge and lower-right edge, with distant city buildings beyond the water. Roads have orange and white light trails, creating a lively night-city effect.

Bottom panel scene: A second version of the same waterfront district, slightly darker and more dramatic, with approximately 14 prominent glass towers and mid-rise buildings. Use cooler blue glass reflections, brighter illuminated windows, stronger road-light trails, green rooftop gardens, and a river or bay curving along the top and lower-right edges. Make the composition visibly similar to the top panel but not identical, so it feels like two different AI model outputs from the same prompt.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed aerial architectural rendering, realistic but slightly idealized, cinematic dusk lighting, blue and teal shadows, warm golden streetlights, crisp glass facades, dense urban planning, marina/waterfront atmosphere, high contrast, sharp perspective, no people visible.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 stacked comparison panels and exactly 2 visible text labels. Keep the labels large, readable, and white with dark outline/shadow. Do not add logos, UI elements, watermarks, captions, or extra text.\
